record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PECK (passive NONE). Shared strategy; they differ by stars and stats. DRILL_PECK is a different ability and is not covered.
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage, 10 / 30 / 50 / 100 raw by the caster's stars (fallback 100), no other effect. The requested amount is the table value; AP scaling (x(1 + AP/100)) and the crit multiplier (only if the cast crit) are applied inside handleSpecialDamage; the target's SPE_DEF division, shields and guards then change the final HP loss, which can be below or above the table value (buffs raise it, defenses and shields lower it; executed: raw 10 with AP 100 against SPE_DEF 0 loses 20, against SPE_DEF 20 loses 10). The returned takenDamage is ignored by PECK (core-mechanics section J1). No status is added.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read here.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true, so the caster's ap is applied); the cast crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: the requested table value is not the final HP loss: handleSpecialDamage returns 0 and blocks the hit for a protected, skydiving or magicBounce target; otherwise handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), rounds up with a minimum of 1, lets a shield absorb first and applies the other shared steps (core-mechanics section A). The returned takenDamage is unused (section J1).

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star and 4-star entries (50 / 100, fallback 100) are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes. maxPP is 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the same damage call.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 10 (Spearow) / 30 (Fearow) raw. Applied: raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor if crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1), shield absorption and the other shared handleDamage steps; the final HP loss can be below or above the table value; the returned takenDamage is unused (section J1). Blocked entirely (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); the SPE_DEF division, shield/HP accounting and the Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band branches were read (shared with the BITE record)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: Whether any item, synergy or passive on the caster or target changes PECK beyond what is listed (the Power Lens retaliation inside handleSpecialDamage was seen but not traced for PECK)
No other unit declares PECK in the queue record; DRILL_PECK (a separate ability) is not covered

Evidence: source reading, mechanical checks and executed probes. The pinned helper text (handleSpecialDamage / handleDamage as used by the strategy) and the real PeckStrategy strategy text were run against stand-in units with controlled callbacks (probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs, section CATCHUP_B2); the whole ability in a real fight, targeting and timing before the cast, and full battles were NOT executed, and nothing was observed in a live game. Executed (target maxHP 1000): the table requests, the doubling of AP 100 or a crit, the SPE_DEF division, a shield and protect.
